build_NPG_trainer: build a Natural Policy Gradient trainer with configurable step size, damping, and conjugate gradient iterations
run_train_from_paths: run the NPG training loop on collected trajectory paths to update the policy parameters
create_HVP_computation: create a Hessian-vector product computation using KL divergence and automatic differentiation for Fisher metric estimation
build_Hvp_eval_closure: build a callable closure that evaluates Hessian-vector products given observations, actions, and a vector
review_NPG_class: review the NPG class initialization parameters including normalized step size, FIM inversion args, and input normalization
